name: sense-family-ai
description: Family calendar, shopping and to-do lists, reminders, chores, meal plans, recipes, and birthdays from Sense, the family organizer.

interface.longDescription:
Sense is the family organizer that keeps everyone on the same page: one shared calendar, shopping and to-do lists, reminders, chores and routines, meal plans and saved recipes, and birthdays, all color-coded per family member and visible to the whole household.

Connect Sense and ChatGPT can look at your family's week and act on it. Ask what's on the calendar this weekend, add soccer practice for a specific kid, put milk and eggs on the shopping list, set a reminder to sign the field trip form, check what's for dinner, or see which chores are still open today. Anything ChatGPT adds shows up in the Sense app right away for everyone in the family, exactly as if you had typed it in yourself.

You sign in with your Sense account; ChatGPT acts as you and sees only what you can see. Disconnect at any time from Settings in Sense.
capabilities: Read and add family calendar events
defaultPrompt: What's on the family calendar this weekend?
Put milk and eggs on the shopping list.

positive.description: Read the family calendar for a date range and summarize it by day and family member, using the events returned rather than inventing any.
positive.prompt: What's on the family calendar this weekend?
positive.expected_behavior: A short day-by-day summary of the weekend's events with times and which family member each belongs to, matching the get_events result. No fabricated events.

positive.description: Create a calendar event assigned to a named family member, resolving the member by id from the family list first.
positive.prompt: Add soccer practice for Ethan next Tuesday at 4pm.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the event was added for Ethan next Tuesday at 4:00 PM and shows the resolved date. The event appears on the family calendar in Sense.

positive.description: Add several items to the family's shopping list in one call.
positive.prompt: Put milk, eggs, and bananas on the shopping list.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms milk, eggs, and bananas were added to the shopping list; the items show in the Sense app.

positive.description: Create a dated reminder with a due time.
positive.prompt: Remind me Thursday morning to sign the field trip form.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms a reminder titled about signing the field trip form for Thursday morning, with the resolved date and time.

positive.description: Read this week's meal plan and answer from it.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the planned dinners by day from the meal plan, or says plainly that nothing is planned yet. No invented meals.

negative.description: General questions unrelated to the family's data must not trigger Sense tools.
A destructive request without a clear target should be clarified, not executed blindly.
Requests for another family's or another person's data are refused; the plugin only acts as the signed-in user.
negative.prompt: Show me the Johnsons' family calendar for next week.

review.commerce_description: Sense does not sell products or process payments through ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: family calendar, shopping and to-do lists, reminders, chores, meal plans, recipes, and birthdays from Sense.
